name: pair
description: Pair or three-agent team across Claude Code tabs — a driver does the task, integrates and reports; a navigator (pair) or an architect and a tester (team) review the plan before any work, approve the gated items, review the rest asynchronously and verify the result themselves; free conversation, a seven-type protocol, review requests with revisions and quoted evidence, a shared state file, all over cross-session messages in the same working directory
